author: Praxis I
title: Dual BRBG: PBVE 0.5 + Cluster-Bridge Graph Augmentation (k=48)
abstract: Starting from PBVE alpha=0.5 and balanced kNN k=48, add a minimal intra-cluster bridge (in Zcorr) to fix micro-fragmentation in the quota graph. Edges remain binary and symmetric. Goal: raise Graph_conn without harming iLISI/kBET or biology metrics.
